name: Status.io
summary: Status.io sells hosted status pages with no free plan. Paid plans cost $79 to $349 a month for 500 to 5,000 subscribers, and every plan includes a custom domain. Updates go out by email, SMS, webhook and RSS.

facts.text: Incidents automatically trigger notifications and update component statuses, and the history page keeps past incident and maintenance events.
Subscribers choose which components they receive notifications for and can change their subscriptions at any time.
The page shows 90-day historical status charts, and metrics can come from a Custom Metric API or tools such as New Relic and Pingdom.
A custom domain is included in all plans.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Listed as starting at $999 a month

hiddenCosts: The page offers a 5% discount for annual subscriptions but lists no annual prices.
